name: Content Moderation Link
description: Provides a permissions-aware link that can be used to moderate content using outside sources like email.
project_description: Content Moderation Link lets editors move a moderated entity into a different workflow state by visiting a specially crafted URL of the form /content-moderation-link/process/{state}/{type}/{id} (for example /content-moderation-link/process/published/node/108, or a comma-separated list of IDs when multiple processing is enabled). It builds on the Drupal core Content Moderation module and is permissions-aware: the target transition is only performed if the acting user is authenticated and the core state-transition validator reports the transition as one they are allowed to make. Anonymous requests are redirected to the login page. Site builders can restrict which entity types and which workflow states the links may target from an admin settings form, and a token ([node:moderation-link:<state>]) generates the URL for use in emails, notifications, or other outbound channels. A common use case is giving editors or administrators one-click moderation links inside an email or chat message so they can publish or otherwise advance content without first navigating into the site's edit UI.
